sections.label: The opening
sections.line: From a checklist to an app you calibrate
sections.para: A bold-marked list is already an information system without history or a good interface; build its smallest version in half an hour, use it, log each run, calibrate, and let the flat list become a tree.

sections.label: In short
sections.para: An information system already; what it lacks; no final app; just the bold; a file per run; calibrate; no database, nothing confidential.

sections.label: You already have an information system
sections.line: You already have an information system
sections.para: A document of actions with the important ones in bold condenses years of experience, and relies on you to read it.

sections.label: What it is missing
sections.para: No history, reliance on memory, little context, and a flat interface where you want three things, then the next five.

sections.label: Do not aim for the final app
sections.line: Do not aim for the final app
sections.para: The simplest thing built through an LLM, deployed, usable and adding value; start by showing only the bold, built in half an hour.

sections.label: The loop is the product
sections.para: Use shows which five matter and which steps depend on others; calibrating every time turns the flat file into a tree.

sections.label: Memory is a small file per run
sections.line: Memory is a small file per run
sections.para: Each run leaves a file of what was used, skipped and what happened; those files are the memory the next version is built from.

sections.label: Start with no database, and nothing confidential
sections.line: Start with no database, and nothing confidential
sections.para: Browser storage or a shared account first; leave out the address and the PIN codes, so the first version can be public and shared by publishing.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.para: Advice, not a tested method; the example is general and unnamed; Lovable is one option.

sections.label: Where this comes from
sections.para: My conversation at the Vibathon Algarve, transcribed word for word.
